reviews.title: I was charged $18.00 instead of the 3 day free trial they offer.
reviews.text:
I was genuinely interested in giving MapXplorer a try, so I downloaded the app. During the registration process, I received a notification stating that I would receive a three-day free trial and that my card would not be charged during that period.

However, the app still required me to provide a payment method, so I selected PayPal. To my surprise, I was immediately charged $18.92 through my Apple subscription, using PayPal as the payment method. So much for the promised free trial!

Despite this unexpected charge, I decided to give the app a chance, hoping its features would justify the expense. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing from the very beginning.

One of the most frustrating issues is the app’s inability to search for businesses or locations by name. Instead, it seems to require an exact street address unless the location already exists in its database.

For example, if you search for “Ross,” expecting to find nearby Ross stores, the app displays streets containing the word “Ross” rather than actual business locations.

In my case, I searched for “Vermeer,” an equipment dealership. Instead of showing nearby Vermeer locations, the app suggested streets named Vermeer in California, even though I live in Kansas and had already enabled location tracking.

Eventually, I entered the dealership’s exact street address. However, instead of displaying the location using MapXplorer’s supposedly enhanced mapping technology, the app simply asked me which navigation s

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with MapExplorer and the overall customer experience. I paid for a subscription expecting to access the app’s full navigation and premium features, but instead I have spent most of my time fighting constant login issues that have never been properly resolved.

For weeks now, the app either refuses to log me in, gets stuck during authentication, or repeatedly throws errors that prevent me from accessing my account. Because of this, I have been locked out of features that I already paid for. What makes this even more frustrating is that my subscription time is still running out while I am unable to fully use the service.

I have tried everything from resetting passwords, reinstalling the app, clearing cache/data, updating the app, and attempting to log in on different devices and networks, but nothing consistently works. The issue clearly seems to be on the app’s side.
